research_goal.question: Which method performs best across the four benchmark datasets?
research_goal.message: Fed-SOLO is consistently strongest across the evaluated datasets.

transformations: Parsed verified numeric strings as floats while preserving dataset and method order.

design.graphic_grammar: grouped bars with open axes, light y-grid, and hatch redundancy
design.layout_request: double-column landscape with a two-row top legend

assumptions: No uncertainty or raw replicates were supplied, so no error bars are shown.
The user explicitly delegated unspecified visual decisions and approved the recommended general double-column publication layout.
acceptance_criteria: All 16 supplied values are represented exactly once.
The y-axis starts at zero because bar length encodes magnitude.
Every method remains distinguishable in the grayscale preview.
The legend and labels do not obscure data at final export size.
Outer export margins are compact without clipping artists.
